wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap building relation 11989546 joins a 71-vertex outer shell about 296 by 273 m to a four-corner football pitch. Pitch alignment sets the roof axes and anchor. Four mapped access stairs and two western approach polygons control the visible approach. Separate transport stops and adjacent structures are outside the scope. Way 1369362226 follows the elevated concourse and terminating way 1369716350 follows the east ramp. The west ramp is mapped with separate raised approach and bridge polygons.
lodDetails: All levels retain the mapped stadium bowl, open roof, parked panels, tiered seating and raised approaches. Near levels add the perforated screens, structural bracing and additional seating detail.
limitations: Standing stadium in the open-roof football configuration photographed on 17 November 2023. Roof modules are shown parked, with no moving parts. The licensed photograph informs the field, interior and the exposed roof structure. No photograph is embedded.

The named mapped building, elevated concourse, playing field, east ramp alignment and west ramp footprint determine the plan. The facade panel spacing, tiger-stripe perforation pattern, exact seat blocks, roof truss submembers and roof module parking positions are approximated from the published descriptions and dimensional controls.

The original 1024 m elevation field was acquired and frozen before authoring. The coarse dataset includes a deep anomalous return east of the stadium. Foundation depth, ramp gradients, concourse and pitch elevations are registered estimates. The nearby railway, bridge to the north and unattached training grounds are outside the model.
